subject: launcher_options_second_observation
claim: A second observation on r806919.Wizard_1_610 confirms that Ambrose's launcher applies the tested host, port, locale, window and run-folder options through an isolated prepared run while leaving the retail install unchanged.
how_to_repeat: Read Bin/revision.dat from your own install and confirm it reports r806919.Wizard_1_610.
Record SHA-256 hashes of every file in the retail install, sorted by relative path.
Run the built launcher with --client <install> --host 192.0.2.50 --port 54321 --locale es-MX --window 1600x900 --run-dir <temporary folder> --prepare.
Inspect the launcher output and the generated run-folder config.xml without starting WizardGraphicalClient.exe.
Repeat with a temporary launcher configuration that also sets WindowX = 100 and WindowY = 200, using another temporary run folder.
Hash the retail install again and compare the sorted before and after listings.
evidence: The prepared command contained -L 192.0.2.50 54321, -P 0 and -A es-MX, and selected the requested temporary run folder.
The generated config.xml contained IsFullscreen = 0, Resolution = 1600x900, WindowedX = 100, WindowedY = 200 and an empty SilentMetricsURL.
The launcher reported the install revision as r806919.Wizard_1_610 and wrote config.xml, preferences.xml, revision.dat, data.dat and launcher.stamp only to the temporary run folder.
The complete retail-install hash listings contained 22,962 entries both before and after, with zero differences.
The prepared runs exited with status 0 and explicitly reported that nothing was started.
disproof: A second observation on r806919.Wizard_1_610 that changes a retail-install hash, writes a generated launcher file inside the install, or omits one of the recorded command-line or configuration values would refute this finding.
verified_how: A read-only --prepare run and a second prepared run with explicit window coordinates reproduced the command and configuration values above; full SHA-256 listings of the retail install were identical before and after.
